hardwareFreeStatement: Every known-run, final-record and stop-receipt input is an in-memory fixture. The test starts no Runtime, Claude/Codex provider, Python runner, GPU process, filesystem collection or N=20 batch; a pass is contract/ledger evidence only and is never a hardware sample or a stability claim.

consumerSecondCandidateIsolatedReadOnly.note: All 48 original cases still pass on that candidate; the 12 red cases are exactly the frozen edges, so they locate consumer defects rather than a fixture error.
redCases: conflicting duplicate final records fail closed in either order - the candidate keeps only the last read per filename, so unknown-then-observed is still reported observed
an invalid extra safe run file stays unbound and required - a parsed {} / missing-Mission / expected-Mission-but-foreign-provider record is silently skipped instead of staying a required unbound run

contradictory known starts for one provider/run (two concrete Missions, or two concrete sessions) are resolved first-wins, so a final record matching the first start is still reported observed instead of failing closed in either order
a cancel_requested / pending research Agent release, an unconfirmed materializer release and a quarantined / cancel_requested benchmark release are ignored while the Mission aggregate looks confirmed
a paused or idle loopStatus is accepted as explicit stopped intent
an idle null-run Agent (runId:null, missionId:null) with a stopped Mission and an explicit confirmed empty resources array is rejected instead of confirming without fabricating an Agent release
newCasesGreenOnThatCandidate: semantically identical duplicates with nested JSON key order are not a conflict
a concrete unrelated foreign-Mission file is still ignored and never miscounted
a current Agent run that is idle but has no release proof is rejected
a known start missing Mission and session is completed only by the current actual record (consistent duplicate starts/records add no denominator entry)
a DTO never supplies an unknown known-start Mission or session

tests.existingAssertionsUnchanged: The original 48 cases and the 13 cases delivered by the previous revision of this batch (61 total) are byte-for-byte retained and only the 4 new independent known-start cases were inserted; the frozen contract was not weakened.
covers: collectModelObservationEvidence: complete two-Mission final records produce one observed summary with one bound DTO per required run and no unbound evidence

collector denominator: known starts dedupe by provider/run identity; repeated identical snapshots add no required run; a known run with a missing/unreadable/malformed final record and a blank final session keeps its required identity and blocks observation instead of disappearing

Root repro 1: a later unknown or conflict final record invalidates an earlier observed snapshot (no ranking prefers observed over a later unknown/conflict/missing state); duplicate final records with conflicting content fail closed
Root repro 2: the actual record/known-start session is the expected identity, so a DTO carrying its own different session is rejected and never bound
Root repro 3: an unreadable or malformed second run file (and a new safe run file unknown to the start list) remains unbound evidence with a reason and cannot drop out of the denominator

collector binding: foreign provider / conflicting Mission / conflicting session / session-vs-thread disagreement / unsafe or non-.json filename / blank runId and blank or missing identity all stay non-observed; unrelated foreign-Mission files are ignored only when not referenced by a known start; two Missions never relabel each other from a current active Mission

collector known-start conflicts (new): two concrete known starts for one provider/run that disagree on Mission (MIS_A vs MIS_B) or on session (sess_a vs sess_other) are never resolved first-wins - in either list order the summary stays non-observed, observedRunCount is 0, the pair dedupes to exactly one required run and the contradiction is retained in unboundRuns with a nonblank reason, even when the final record matches the originally first-listed start

collector known-start completion (new): a known start missing both Mission and session is completed from the same current-attempt actual record (positive, consistent duplicate starts/records add no denominator entry), while a DTO field never supplies a Mission or session the actual record lacks, and no DTO-supplied identity survives as bound evidence

collector duplicates: the same final state serialized with a different key order is one semantic duplicate, not a conflict; the same holds when the nested modelObservation key order differs too (new positive)

frozen edge (new): the same filename with two final records whose content differs must fail closed in BOTH orders - unknown-then-observed, observed-then-unknown, conflict-then-observed, observed-then-conflict and two valid records naming different models in either order all stay non-observed with the run counted exactly once

frozen edge (new): a safe extra run file whose parsed content is {} or [] or lacks a Mission, or names an expected Mission with a foreign provider, may not be dropped - it stays an unbound required record (requiredRunCount 2) with a nonblank reason and a non-observed summary; a concrete unrelated foreign-Mission file not referenced by a known start is still ignored and never counted

evaluateMissionStopReceipt: real HTTP shape {state} with release in state.workflowRecovery.resourceRelease, exact state.activeMissionId, missionPaused true, stopped loop intent, every listed resource explicitly confirmed with no pending/unconfirmed/quarantined/blocked flag, and (when a current Agent run exists) same-Mission explicit release proof; a top-level resourceRelease is not accepted

stop receipt negatives: missing/malformed/foreign/pending release, missing resources array, unconfirmed or flagless resource, blocked/quarantined resource, running intent, no current Agent proof, current Agent release barrier or foreign Agent Mission, a 202 without proof, and a mismatched requested Mission all stay unconfirmed while HTTP 202 with a proving state may confirm

stop receipt negatives (new): a confirmed Mission aggregate is not enough - a cancel_requested/pending researchAgent, an unconfirmed/barrier baseline.materializer release or a quarantined/cancel_requested benchmark release must each be rejected through the existing cancellation-contract resource barrier; paused and idle loopStatus are not explicit stopped intent and are rejected

stop receipt positive baseline (new): an idle Agent with runId:null and missionId:null over a stopped Mission with an explicitly confirmed resources[] confirms without fabricating an Agent release; the same Agent holding a run but no release proof is still rejected
stop receipt purity: Object.freeze/deep-frozen states are evaluated without mutation on both the confirmed and rejected paths, and every receipt is exercised through the exact {state} shape

ledger: a complete observed per-run proof stays comparable; a declared modelObservationSummary missing or malformed reasons and an observed summary carrying a reason are non-comparable; duplicate aliases with equal config/outcome but contradictory per-run model proof are a duplicate conflict that stays in the denominator exactly once and is never silently deduped to the first good record

boundaries: No live provider, Agent, Runtime, GPU, filesystem collection or N=20 batch is started by this test.
The test creates no production stub: it reads the helpers off the real module namespace and reports an explicit expected-red verdict while they are absent.
The frozen contract is upstream-owned; test authors must not weaken it to match a pre-implementation tree.
A green run of this test is contract/ledger evidence only, never a hardware sample or a stability/performance conclusion.
